targets.name: Harry
targets.description: The protagonist, a writer dying of gangrene on safari in Africa who reflects on the stories he never wrote and the talent he wasted.
targets.physical_description: A man lying on a cot with a gangrenous, rotting right leg.
targets.summary_of_actions: Argues bitterly with his wife, drinks whiskey, remembers his past in Europe and the war, and dies in the night, dreaming of flying to the summit of Kilimanjaro.

targets.name: Helen
targets.description: Harry's wealthy wife, who cares for him in camp and whose money he believes corrupted his writing.
targets.physical_description: A well-built woman with a pleasant body, good legs, and a still-attractive face.
targets.summary_of_actions: Nurses Harry, shoots game for broth, endures his cruelty, and finds him dead at night.

targets.name: Molo
targets.description: Harry's personal servant at the safari camp.
targets.summary_of_actions: Brings Harry drinks, tends the fire, and follows his orders around the camp.

targets.name: Compton
targets.description: The pilot who arrives with a small plane to fly Harry out to medical care.
targets.physical_description: Wears a tweed jacket and a slouch hat.
targets.summary_of_actions: Lands the Puss Moth, has tea, and in Harry's dying dream flies him toward Kilimanjaro.

targets.name: Williamson
targets.description: The bombing officer from Harry's war memories.
targets.summary_of_actions: Is caught in the wire by a stick bomb, begs to be shot, and is given all of Harry's morphine tablets.

targets.name: Barker
targets.description: A pilot from Harry's war memories.
targets.summary_of_actions: Flies across the lines to bomb and machine-gun an Austrian officers' leave train, then tells of it in the mess.

targets.name: Herr Lent
targets.description: A ski-school owner from Harry's memories of the Madlener-haus.
targets.summary_of_actions: Gambles at cards while snowbound and loses everything, including his capital.

targets.name: Tristan Tzara
targets.description: A Roumanian Dadaist from Harry's Paris memories.
targets.summary_of_actions: Talks about the Dada movement and always has a headache.

targets.name: Marie
targets.description: Harry's femme de menage (housekeeper) in Paris.
targets.summary_of_actions: Protests against the eight-hour day, saying working men drink more with shorter hours.
